cause: Source-level tsx execution rewrites the injected removeExcludedRoots helper with __name; the browser has no such Node helper. pageerror confirmed __name is not defined and excluded host remained in top-level document.
resolution: Use actual built CLI for audit orchestration. No exclusion runtime change was warranted. Both CLI captures complete52actions, excludechat, preserve roots, and block only analyticsPOSTs.
workflowRule: Build first, freeze dist, then run actual CLI or Node ESM SDK imports. Do not use tsx around browser-injected functions; a source harness failure does not establish a product defect.
